The '''Pressure Plate Trip''' was a detection device produced by [[Zone Supplies, Ltd.]]<ref name="CRFG" /> The device was activated when it detected a minimum amount of pressure applied to its surface. This amount was adjustable and could be used to detect personnel and vehicles.<ref name="RoE" /> It came in two sizes; the small version was 30 square centimeters and weighed 300 [[gram]]s, while the large was one square meter and weighed a [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]]. The pad could be rolled up when not in used, and had adaptors to connect the plate to a variety of defensive measures, including alarms, [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], and [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]]. It was supplied in a variety of colors for camouflage purposes. Standard issue to the forces of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] standard procedure was to cover the plate with a shallow layer of dirt or available appropriate material to assist in disguising the plate.<ref name="CRFG" />
